title: TAI owner canonical images command
objective: Provide an owner-only issue command that dispatches the existing canonical Docker image workflow for unchanged current main when an app-authored merge does not emit a usable push workflow, allowing the already-merged automatic REG.RU preflight, activation, acceptance, deployment and strict postflight chain to proceed without creating another source commit.
boundaries: The only command is /tai images current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must all equal the repository owner
The command resolves and revalidates unchanged origin/main before dispatch
Only the existing Build & Publish Canonical Docker Images workflow is dispatched with ref main and services all
The command has no Docker, SSH, sudo, production filesystem, database or application mutation authority
Production mutation remains NONE until the downstream protected REG.RU controller accepts preflight evidence
The existing automatic preflight, activation, live acceptance, rollback, deployment and strict postflight workflows remain the sole release authority
Every accepted command publishes the exact target SHA and a pending canonical-image status
